column6: mode switch drains the GPU, releases pools, resets the system heap around menu dispatch, and clears player motion
column7: five proven calls: player_update supplies only mode zero, while map_interaction supplies modes one or two plus an item/event byte; calls DrawSync, pool_release_all, memory_reset_system_heap, menu_root, item_use_confirm, item_menu_root, and player_clear_motion; no strings
column8: prologue saves a0 through a3 in their O32 caller home slots before allocating the frame, proving a variadic boundary; mode is signed full-width and modes one/two read the low byte of the first optional argument; v0 carries the selected menu result
